strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚⋯⋯{NEWLINE}难道是电话⋯⋯坏了么？{SCROLL}你换个地方再打过来吧！
strings.en: Huh? I can’t hear you very well!{NEWLINE}I think we’ve got a bad connection.{SCROLL}Call me back from somewhere else!

strings.zh: 喂喂！你最近怎么样？{NEWLINE}我还是老样子哈。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello? How are you?{NEWLINE}I’m doing great as usual!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 除了我之外还有很多{NEWLINE}厉害的关注吧。{SCROLL}你现在在巡回{NEWLINE}全国的道馆吗？{CLEAR}好厉害！加油啊！
strings.en: Besides me, there are lots of other{NEWLINE}tough Gym Leaders, right? Are you{CLEAR}touring Gyms all over the country now?{CLEAR}That’s amazing! Keep it up!
strings.notes: US 0658/3 | RV071: meaning: no 'stronger than me'; zh typo 关注 for 馆主 (hack-finding D-2230)

strings.zh: 我星期四的白天{NEWLINE}会有空闲时间！{CLEAR}想来看我的虫精灵的话,{CLEAR}就给我打个电话吧！
strings.en: On Thursdays around noon, I’m{NEWLINE}usually free.{CLEAR}If you want to see my Bug-type Pokémon{CLEAR}again, you should call me then!

strings.zh: 啊,你电话来的真是时候,{NEWLINE}我现在正好很闲！{CLEAR}想和我再来对战一次吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Oh, you called at just the right time!{NEWLINE}I’m not doing anything right now.{CLEAR}Wanna battle again? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 太好了！{SCROLL}那我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你！
strings.en: All right!{SCROLL}Then I’ll be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle Frontier!
strings.notes: US 0658/6 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.en: I see...{NEWLINE}Well, there’s no helping that...

strings.zh: 哎？{NEWLINE}我是不介意和你战斗啦,{CLEAR}但你不是还有和其他人{CLEAR}有过预约了吗？{SCROLL}那我就不能接受你的预约了,{NEWLINE}下次再打电话吧。
strings.en: Huh? I don’t mind battling you, but{NEWLINE}don’t you already have plans with{CLEAR}someone else? Then I can’t take your{CLEAR}appointment. Call me again another time.
strings.notes: US 0658/8 | RV071: omission: refusal of the appointment restored

strings.zh: 那我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你！{CLEAR}尽快来啊！
strings.en: Then I’ll be waiting for you at{NEWLINE}the Trainer House at the Battle{CLEAR}Frontier! Come as soon as you can!
strings.notes: US 0658/9 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 我们不是约好了在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋对战的吗？{CLEAR}你可不能放我鸽子啊！
strings.en: Didn’t we agree to battle at{NEWLINE}the Trainer House at the Battle{CLEAR}Frontier? Please don’t stand me up!
strings.notes: US 0658/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 小时候,大家都{NEWLINE}非常喜欢虫精灵的,{SCROLL}可长大了之后,{NEWLINE}不知不觉间都{CLEAR}开始讨厌虫精灵了。{SCROLL}你是怎么想的呢？{NEWLINE}还喜欢虫精灵吗？{SCROLL}我就算长成大人,{NEWLINE}也绝不会{CLEAR}讨厌虫精灵的！
strings.en: You know, everyone loves Bug-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon when they’re kids. But once{CLEAR}they grow up, somewhere along the{CLEAR}way, they all start to hate them.{SCROLL}How about you? Do you still like{NEWLINE}Bug-type Pokémon?{SCROLL}Even when I’m a grown-up, I’ll never{NEWLINE}hate Bug-type Pokémon!
strings.notes: US 0658/12 | RV071: softened: 讨厌 is 'hate', not 'like less'

strings.zh: 我道馆里的布置{NEWLINE}是不是很独特呢？{SCROLL}虽然看上去做成这样{NEWLINE}是件很累人的事⋯⋯{CLEAR}但实际上很简单,{SCROLL}只要张开网,{NEWLINE}然后所有的精灵{CLEAR}就会帮我挂上去！
strings.en: My Gym’s setup is{NEWLINE}pretty unique, isn’t it?{SCROLL}It looks like it must have been{NEWLINE}a lot of work to make... But{CLEAR}it was actually really easy.{SCROLL}All we did was spread out{NEWLINE}the webs, and then all the{CLEAR}Pokémon hung them up for us!

strings.zh: 好像我之前跟你说过,{NEWLINE}我在进行{CLEAR}虫精灵的研究对吧？{SCROLL}他们有很多的种类,{NEWLINE}所以这项研究是很累的。{SCROLL}光是虫精灵{NEWLINE}就搞得我精力憔悴,{SCROLL}对所有{NEWLINE}精灵进行研究的{CLEAR}空木和大木博士{CLEAR}真的好厉害啊。
strings.en: I think I’ve already mentioned this to{NEWLINE}you, but did you know I’m doing{CLEAR}research on Bug-type Pokémon?{SCROLL}There’s so many different kinds, it’s a{NEWLINE}bit difficult, you know?{SCROLL}I’m just studying Bug-type Pokémon,{NEWLINE}and yet it’s still this difficult.{SCROLL}People like Professor Elm and{NEWLINE}Professor Oak who study all the{CLEAR}different types of Pokémon are really{CLEAR}something else, you know?
